key.name: open-mode
key.description: "touch" = open on touch/tap events over a Clutter.Text actor. "click" = open on any pointer button-press over a Clutter.Text actor. "always" = open whenever Main.inputMethod.currentFocus is set, regardless of input device.

key.name: enable-poll
key.description: When true, poll every 300ms. In "Always" mode: opens/closes on IM focus. In "Click" or "Touch" mode: only closes on focus loss (open is triggered by click/touch events). Catches apps that never raise input-panel-state.

key.name: force-touch-mode
key.description: Patches the native KeyboardManager so the OSK is enabled even on sessions where no touchscreen was detected.

key.name: ignore-password-fields
key.summary: Don't open the OSK for password fields
key.description: Avoid opening the OSK on input-purpose PASSWORD fields, letting the native panel-state behaviour handle those.

key.name: click-threshold-ms
key.summary: Max delay between click and text-field focus in "click" mode
key.description: In "click" mode the OSK opens when a text field gains input-method focus within this many milliseconds of a pointer press. XWayland apps (Chromium, Vivaldi) can take 1-2s to report IM focus after a click, so the old 500ms window was too short. Tune up if your apps are slower, down to avoid opening after click-then-Tab sequences.
